name: pdf-contact
command:
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import sys
pages = sorted(Path(sys.argv[1]).glob('page-*.png'))
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (1040, 1040), '#dedede')
for index, path in enumerate(pages):
    page = Image.open(path).convert('RGB')
    page.thumbnail((250, 506))
    sheet.paste(page, ((index%4)*260+5, (index//4)*520+5))
sheet.save(Path(sys.argv[1])/'contact.png')
